name: ema61_breakout/monthly_weekly_stop_nifty200_size_dd
description: Monthly EMA61 breakout, entry only when weekly and daily closes are above EMA61; stop at previous week's low (fixed). No new entries while NIFTY 50 is below its 200-day average (Sensex before mid-2008). Sizing: half risk after a 10% fall from the equity high until a new high; no new trades for 21 trading days on reaching 15%.
